sample.question_description: Find the first blocked move in a command sequence.
sample.question_preview: Using the Skybridge 3D movement rules, which command is the first one that fails? Sequence: up, down, up, right, up, right. Options: [1] move 6 [2] move 4 [3]...
sample.question:
Using the Skybridge 3D movement rules, which command is the first one that fails? Sequence: up, down, up, right, up, right.
Options:
[1] move 6
[2] move 4
[3] move 2
[4] no move is blocked
[5] move 3
[6] move 5
[7] move 1
sample.analysis:
Move 1 up: moved (ladder edge).
Move 2 down: moved (normal height rule).
Move 3 up: moved (ladder edge).
Move 4 right: moved (normal height rule).
Move 5 up: blocked (outside the board).
Move 6 right: moved (normal height rule).
The first failing command is move 5. Therefore choose option 6.

state_content.rules: Move between adjacent towers. Climb up at most 1 level normally; ladder edges allow climbing up 2 levels. Descending is always allowed.
